documents.title: Sofos After School Program 2026-2027 — Welcome & Schedule Info
documents.summaryLong: Brian Yee, director of the Sofos After School program at Carolyn Clark, confirmed the program starts Monday, August 17, 2026 in Room C106 right after dismissal, running 2:35-6:00PM each school day (check-in, two recess breaks, a 3:15-4:30 homework/work block, and iPad/craft time from 5:00-5:40). Minimum days add a movie after the work block; Fridays usually add a game/activity since there's typically no homework. Families on the 3-day/4-day plan need to email Brian back with which days Nollen will attend. No food is provided, so pack extra for after school. Monthly tuition posts to the online account (https://campsself.active.com/mathenrichment0) on the 1st or 2nd school day and auto-charges any card on file — Brian recommends saving a card. Pickup is at Room C106 any time before 6:00PM; bring photo ID during the first week, and notify staff in advance if someone not on the list will be picking up. Contacts: Brian Yee (408-679-8196), JM Malit (408-712-1307).
documents.summaryShort: Sofos After School for Nollen starts Mon, Aug 17, 2026 in Room C106, running 2:35-6:00PM daily. If he's on a 3-day/4-day plan, reply to Brian Yee (408-679-8196) with which days he'll attend. Monthly tuition auto-charges any card on file around the 1st-2nd school day via the online account — worth saving a card. Pack extra food (none provided) and bring photo ID for pickup during the first week.

documents.title: Ms. Marcias — Welcome Letter (Nollen's Teacher, 2026–2027)
documents.summaryLong: Bernadette Marcias, Nollen's teacher for 2026-2027 at Carolyn Clark Elementary, introduced herself as a 27-year educator (23rd year at Carolyn Clark) who also serves as the school's Administrative Designee. She stressed that attendance during the first 10 days is critical since class placements are provisional and could be reshuffled based on enrollment. A detailed class syllabus will come home next week to review together as a family. She's hosting a Meet & Greet on August 14 (today) from 1:30-2:30pm in Room C215, and can be reached at bmarcias@eesd.org or via the school office voicemail at 408-223-4560. She also encouraged families to join the Carolyn Clark PTA (goal: 100% participation) at https://jointotem.com/ca/san-jose/carolyn-clark-pta.
documents.summaryShort: Nollen's teacher, Bernadette Marcias, is holding a Meet & Greet today, August 14, 1:30-2:30pm in Room C215. Attendance during the first 10 days is important since class placements are still provisional. A full syllabus comes home next week. documents.title: Generations in Conversation — Grandparent Interview Project
documents.summaryLong: Ms. Marcias is relaunching a class project called Generations in Conversation, where small student groups interview a visiting grandparent about their life and experiences, then create a short video montage celebrating their guest. She's asking for 6-8 grandparents to volunteer for a visit on Thursday, August 27, from 8:30-10:00am, and notes translation support will be arranged so grandparents can share their story in whichever language they're most comfortable with. Snacks will be provided for the guests. Families with an available and willing grandparent should let the teacher know.
documents.summaryShort: Ms. Marcias needs 6-8 grandparent volunteers for a class interview project on Thursday, Aug 27, 8:30-10am. Students will interview a grandparent and make a short video about their story. Translation support is available, so language isn't a barrier. Let the teacher know if a grandparent can attend.

documents.title: Clark's Meet & Greet & New Family Orientation — Reminder
documents.summaryLong: Carolyn Clark Elementary's Student Council sent a reminder for the school-wide Meet & Greet and New Family Orientation on Friday, August 14, 2026. Classroom assignments post to the Parent Portal after 4:00pm, but families should watch for an email from the teacher with the room number around 11:00am beforehand; Student Council members will be stationed out front to help families find classrooms, and all students must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. The schedule runs TK/Kindergarten 1:00-1:30pm, Grades 1-6 1:30-2:30pm, and New Family Orientation & School Tours 2:45-3:30pm in the School Forum. While on campus, families can also grab free books from the San Jose Public Library, visit a photo-op station, buy Clark T-shirts, and get food from Mel's Grub Hut (proceeds benefit Student Council).
documents.summaryShort: Clark's Meet & Greet and New Family Orientation is Friday, Aug 14, 2026 — Grades 1-6 (Nollen and Austin) meet 1:30-2:30pm, with New Family Orientation & tours 2:45-3:30pm in the Forum. Watch for the teacher's email around 11am with the classroom number; a parent/guardian must accompany students. Free library books, a photo-op station, T-shirt sales, and Mel's Grub Hut food truck will also be on campus.
